## Operators

Arithmetic (`+ - * / %`), comparison (`== != < >`), logical (`&& || !`). `&&` and `||` short-circuit.

## Branching

`if/else`, and the modern **switch expression** (Java 14+) with arrow labels returns a value and requires no `break`.

## Loops

`for`, enhanced `for` (for-each), `while`, `do/while`. Use `break`/`continue` sparingly.
